page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is an x86_64 server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.9 GHz. It features 1 physical core with hyperthreading enabled, providing 2 dedicated virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, which equals 4.0 GB per vCPU. System cache details include 48 KB of L1d cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache. Hardware flags confirm support for AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, VAES, SHA-NI, and FMA instruction set extensions. This instance does not include bundled local disk storage and relies entirely on external network storage, while baseline network throughput is rated at 1 Gbps.

In synthetic benchmarks, single-core CPU operations show steady average results, recorded by a stress-ng single-core score of 1842.18, a Geekbench single-core score of 1556.0, and single-threaded gzip compression speed of 27.62 GB/sec. Due to the single physical core limit, multi-threaded capacity remains constrained, yielding a stress-ng multi-core score of 1932.39 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 1815.0. Uncached memory bandwidth tests record 15.1 GB/sec for large block reads and 13.63 GB/sec for writes. Database operations and web traffic processing reflect similar resource bounds, with PassMark database performance measured at 1038.28 operations and static web serving throughput reaching 3.5 GB/sec.

The instance presents a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, delivering cost efficiency for basic workloads that require guaranteed CPU resource allocation rather than high parallel throughput. Lacking discrete GPUs or local NVMe drives, it avoids hardware overhead for tasks that do not need specialized acceleration. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is well suited for lightweight web serving, small internal API services, entry-level microservices, basic text processing, and background utility tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose x86_64 instance featuring an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 1 physical core and 2 threads, offering 2 dedicated vCPUs along with 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio. Its architecture includes 48 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, and SHA-NI. The instance lacks local disk storage and discrete GPU accelerators, operating with a 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate average single-threaded CPU capability, supported by a Geekbench single-core score of 1556.0 and steady decompression speeds. However, limited physical core count restricts parallel processing, resulting in lower relative multi-threaded and memory bandwidth metrics. Qualitatively, the instance offers balanced resource allocation for entry-level server roles. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large fits lightweight web applications, entry-level microservices, small API gateways, and basic utility workloads that prioritize reliable single-threaded execution.
